items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: He used to be with the old-time Waterville comedians, Eddie Chittenden and Ralph Nugas and Paul Soipass.

ctx.x: What was your uncle's name then?

My uncle's name was Dewey Schmid. He's at present District Fire Chief of the city. But he also went with the name of Wilbur Leroy. He used to be with the old-time Waterville comedians, Eddie Chittenden and Ralph Nugas and Paul Soipass. They played the old No Name Theater and all the old theaters and the old days. So, he's still around.
He'd be a good person who likes to see, wouldn't he?
